title: Output Record
governance_note: Output growth should not be treated as complete social progress.

title: Growth Record
governance_note: Growth-rate assumptions compound strongly over time.

title: Capital Record
governance_note: Capital stock measures can hide quality, maintenance, and obsolescence.

title: Productivity Record
governance_note: Productivity should not be used as a residual without interpretation.

title: Adjustment Record
governance_note: Instant adjustment assumptions can hide overshoot and persistence.

title: Constraint Record
governance_note: Unconstrained growth assumptions should be compared with constrained scenarios.

title: Claim Boundary
governance_note: Economic conclusions should not exceed output definitions, data evidence, structural assumptions, uncertainty, distributional interpretation, and tested scope.
